notes.title: From Beta to Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I've been working hard to add new features and fix others thanks to your feedback!

Some of the things that are in this version:
[list]
[*] New and improved UI
[*] Better enemy AI
[*] More enemies with fun synergies between them
[*] and a bunch of bug fixes!
[/list]

Also, there is a [url=https://discord.gg/WDyrvFqYbA]Brand new Discord server![/url] to help make Aurora even better! Join and discuss Aurora or game development in general. If you have the time there is a [url=https://forms.gle/LoaVcXLN2njmp5ocA]Feedback Form[/url] you can fill out :)

Keep on fighting and if you want to have more regular updates you can join the beta builds!

notes.title: New Beta out now!
notes.content:
There is a new Beta to try! Among a bunch of things included we have:

- new Enemies
- new Bosses
- incredible Cutscenes
- new Powerups and Skills
- support for Mouse & Keyboard
- and a lot more content!

Go now and try it out! Under the game's properties, go to Beta and enable the beta branch!

notes.title: New Demo Available! More content and more adventures!
notes.content:
[h1]Check out the latest demo now! Begin exciting enhanced journeys![/h1]

We're excited to introduce the newest demo for our game, filled with thrilling new features to enhance your experience! This update brings in [b]additional content[/b], [b]improved mechanics[/b], and exciting new features such as [b]modifiers[/b], [b]companions[/b], and [b]new and smarter enemies[/b].

Modifiers add variation to every round, guaranteeing that each run is unique. Adjust your tactics and experiment with the different ways in which modifiers can alter the course of gameplay, ranging from enhancing advantages to presenting stimulating obstacles.

At the same time, fellow adventurers team up with you, providing useful skills and introducing a new level of tactics. Select your allies carefully in order to enhance your preferred style of play and gain an advantage in any situation.

However, that is not the only thing—prepare yourself for fresh enemies! These enemies are more intelligent, resilient, and varied than before, prepared to challenge your abilities and keep you alert. Every new opponent in this updated roster brings even more excitement and satisfaction to every confrontation.

Exciting experiences are on the horizon! Get the demo today and confront these thrilling new tasks. Share your feedback as we collaborate to develop the game further.

Begin your adventure now - test out the new demo today and embrace the surprises that await you!
